constraints: EVERY ROW IS A CANDIDATE, NOT A BUG. A dangling region is frequently the intended TU-wide setting: game/sys/memcard is top_of_file, covers all 30 of its functions, and is LOAD-BEARING (closing it aborts the build on memCardErrorPrompt's webfrank body hash and takes saveMount and vmu_exists off their bytes). Before acting on any row, run the per-TU load-bearing test: close the region, defake_gate baseline <unit> --at-head, defake_gate check <unit> --rebuild.

The function parser is a heuristic. Two-sided calibration against fndiff.raw_signature over 36 units / 970 real functions at b00285ce3: false-positive 60, missed 63 (al_pragma_extent: 97 and 73). 52 of the misses are one file, game/movie/movieplayer, where an extern "C" block wrapping the TU defeats brace tracking; such files print PARSE-FAIL rather than a coverage of zero, because an unparsed file otherwise reads as 'no functions affected'.
name: mc_pragma_regions
purpose: Image-wide census of UNCLOSED #pragma regions across every src/ translation unit and every stateful pragma family, with each region's covering functions and a top_of_file/after_paired shape split. Complements al_pragma_extent, which answers a narrower question: that tool is keyed to the ADDR16_LO census roster (45 units, and it exits if build/GUNE5D/al_addrlo_positive.json is absent) and tracks only opt_propagation.
usage: Run from the repo root; writes build/GUNE5D/mc_pragma_regions.json. --bare-closes-all inverts the leak law's bare-reset assumption so both readings can be compared (37 regions vs 36).
